crossProjectRisks.title: Production runtime has not been verified on the target Hostinger VPS
crossProjectRisks.details: Build and static checks pass, but end-to-end runtime on the real server, domains, reverse proxy, SSL, uploads, mail, and payment callbacks are not yet proven.

crossProjectRisks.title: Database/schema consistency must be proven against the actual production database
crossProjectRisks.details: Code references some raw SQL tables and feature paths that must exist in the live database or runtime failures will occur.

crossProjectRisks.title: Automated test coverage is not reliable
crossProjectRisks.details: Backend has no discoverable tests under current Jest config, and mobile tests fail due to preset resolution.

crossProjectRisks.title: Admin static quality gate still fails
crossProjectRisks.details: Admin lint reports many no-explicit-any, hook dependency, and one theme provider initialization issue.

crossProjectRisks.title: Production secrets and third-party integrations still need real validation
crossProjectRisks.details: SMTP, AFS, JWT/NEXTAUTH secrets, and domain routing are configured by examples only until proven on the server.
